title: LunarLeaf-CFD: a validated in-browser CFD model of gravity-dependent gas-exchange boundary layers around Arabidopsis
description:
A browser-based lattice-Boltzmann model that solves incompressible flow, multi-species (CO2/O2/H2O) advection-diffusion and Boussinesq buoyancy under an adjustable gravity vector. The solver is validated against four numerical benchmarks (lid-driven cavity, cylinder wake, natural-convection cavity, pure diffusion) and anchored to measured Arabidopsis whole-plant-chamber gas exchange.

It quantifies how reduced gravity thickens the leaf gas-exchange boundary layer and steepens O2/CO2/H2O gradients across three scales (single leaf, rosette, microgreen canopy); the forced airflow needed to counteract the microgravity penalty at each scale; the three ISS plant-growth systems (BRIC sealed, CARA micropore tape, VEGGIE ventilated) as dish boundary conditions; and, with CO2-limited photosynthesis, the resulting carbon-gain deficit. Includes the full results package and a draft manuscript.

Source code is MIT-licensed; the manuscript and figures under results/ are CC-BY-4.0. Raw third-party measurement data are not redistributed and are referenced by provenance.
